hero.title: Every coupon, redemption and bondholder vote — executed on-chain
hero.lead: Record date, per-holder entitlements, escrowed settlement and ISO 20022 reporting for tokenized bonds, under Kazakhstan market rules.

last.title: Last corporate action
last.holders: {count, plural, one {# holder paid} other {# holders paid}}

how.title: From record date to payout in five on-chain steps

register.title: Register
register.text: Investors pass KYC; the provider attests it on Solana (SAS) and the registrar admits the wallet.

record.title: Record date
record.text: The bond mint is paused and every holder's position is snapshotted on-chain.

entitle.title: Entitlements
entitle.text: Per-holder amounts under 30E/360, rounded half-up, with resident and non-resident tax.

pay.title: Escrow & payout
pay.text: The issuer funds an escrow; payouts run in batches and withheld tax goes to a tax vault.

report.title: Report
report.text: ISO 20022 seev.031 / seev.036 files and a KASE-style notice are generated from chain state.

scenarios.title: The corporate actions a bond actually lives through

coupon.title: Coupon
coupon.text: 1,000 ₸ face, 10% paid semi-annually. Holders of 10, 25 and 65 bonds receive 500, 1,250 and 3,250 ₸.

redemption.title: Redemption
redemption.text: At maturity holders receive the principal plus the final coupon; the bonds are burned and the series is closed.

meeting.title: Bondholder meeting
meeting.text: Holders vote with snapshot weights to raise the coupon from 10% to 12%; quorum and majority are checked on-chain.

early.title: Early redemption
early.text: The issuer calls the bonds early; interest accrued over the 47 days since the last coupon is paid with the principal.

issuers.title: For issuers
issuers.b1: Issue a series from its terms in minutes
issuers.b2: Fund each coupon into escrow — the registrar does the rest
issuers.b3: Call bondholder meetings and change terms with a full audit trail

investors.title: For investors
investors.b1: Holdings, next coupon and every payout with its transaction
investors.b2: Subscribe at par with delivery versus payment
investors.b3: Vote in bondholder meetings from your own wallet

simulated.title: Implemented vs simulated
simulated.note: Meeting thresholds (quorum 50%, approval ⅔ of votes cast) are series configuration, not a statement of Kazakh law.

core.element: Bond token, holder registry, record date, entitlements, coupon payment, redemption, burn and close, voting, terms change, on-chain events

cash.text: Real token transfers in devnet USDC (Circle) and test tKZT (Token-2022). Fiat tenge and the digital tenge are stood in for by our mint.

kyc.text: Attested on-chain: a demo KYC-provider key issues a Solana Attestation Service attestation per wallet, and registration refuses wallets without a live, matching one. The provider is not a licensed KYC firm.

iso.text: Generated from on-chain state; Swift delivery is replaced by downloadable files.

ardfm.element: ARDFM registration of a terms change
ardfm.text: Represented by a registrar signature step.

notice.text: Generated automatically; publication on kase.kz is not integrated.

footer.devnet: Runs on Solana devnet with test tokens — no real money moves.
